about: SPD-07: the regrade pass waits while a review runs or is open, so a stored game's summary does not wait on the page thread. Graded by gate 147 TC-R439 at kunal761 (CT_G147_ONLY=review runs that block alone). NOT COVERED: 320x568 (one geometry; the pass is not layout), and the new-against-old blocks of the same gate (TC-R223, its own pairs file).

breaks.name: the-regrade-pass-runs-through-the-review
breaks.why: the regrade pass no longer waits for a running or open review, so its replays of his stored games hold the page thread through the review again
